SELECT MEMBER_ID AS memberId, MEMBER_NAME AS memberName, NICKNAME AS memberNickName, EMAIL AS email, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, MEMBER_STATUS AS memberStatus, PLAN_COUNT AS planCount, REPORTED_PLAN_COUNT AS reportedPlanCount FROM ( SELECT ordered_member.*, ROWNUM AS RN FROM ( SELECT member.MEMBER_ID, member.MEMBER_NAME, member.NICKNAME, member.EMAIL, member.CREATED_AT, member.MEMBER_STATUS, COUNT(DISTINCT plan.PLAN_ID) AS PLAN_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT report.PLAN_ID) AS REPORTED_PLAN_COUNT FROM MEMBER member LEFT JOIN TRAVEL_PLAN plan ON plan.OWNER_MEMBER_ID = member.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN REPORT report ON report.PLAN_ID = plan.PLAN_ID WHERE 1 = 1
AND (member.MEMBER_NAME LIKE '%' || #{search.keyword} || '%' OR member.NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{search.keyword} || '%' OR member.EMAIL LIKE '%' || #{search.keyword} || '%')
AND member.MEMBER_STATUS = #{search.memberStatus}
GROUP BY member.MEMBER_ID, member.MEMBER_NAME, member.NICKNAME, member.EMAIL, member.CREATED_AT, member.MEMBER_STATUS ORDER BY member.CREATED_AT DESC, member.MEMBER_ID DESC ) ordered_member WHERE ROWNUM <= (#{search.page} * #{search.size}) ) WHERE RN > ((#{search.page} - 1) * #{search.size})

SELECT member.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, member.MEMBER_NAME AS memberName, member.NICKNAME AS nickName, member.EMAIL AS email, member.PHONE_NUMBER AS phoneNumber, member.BIRTH_DATE AS birthDate, member.MEMBER_STATUS AS memberStatus, member.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, COUNT(DISTINCT plan.PLAN_ID) AS planCount, COUNT(DISTINCT report.PLAN_ID) AS reportedPlanCount FROM MEMBER member LEFT JOIN TRAVEL_PLAN plan ON plan.OWNER_MEMBER_ID = member.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN REPORT report ON report.PLAN_ID = plan.PLAN_ID WHERE member.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} GROUP BY member.MEMBER_ID, member.MEMBER_NAME, member.NICKNAME, member.EMAIL, member.PHONE_NUMBER, member.BIRTH_DATE, member.MEMBER_STATUS, member.CREATED_AT
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET MEMBER_STATUS = #{memberStatus}, WITHDRAWN_AT = CASE WHEN #{memberStatus} = 'WITHDRAWN' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
